title: Truchas 2D mesh
description: A two-dimensional mesh read from an external file or generated from two axis grids.

axis-grid.description: A monotone axis grid defined by coarse-grid breakpoints and the number of intervals in each segment.

coarse-grid.description: Increasing coordinate breakpoints. The number of entries must be one greater than the number of intervals.

intervals.description: Number of generated intervals in each coarse-grid segment.

ratio.description: Optional geometric progression ratio for each coarse-grid segment. A value of 1 gives uniform spacing.

external-mesh.description: A two-dimensional mesh read from an Exodus-compatible mesh file.

mesh-file.description: Path to the external mesh file. Relative paths are resolved relative to the input file.

coord-scale-factor.description: Factor applied to all mesh coordinates.

rotation-angle.description: Counterclockwise rotation angle in degrees about the origin.

exodus-block-modulus.description: Optional positive modulus used to merge Exodus element-block IDs. Zero disables normalization.

generated-mesh.description: A mesh generated from Cartesian x and y axis grids.

element-type.description: Element topology. Use quad for quadrilaterals or tri for triangles.

triangle-probability.description: For a quadrilateral grid, probability that each cell is subdivided into two triangles.

noise-factor.description: Maximum random perturbation of generated mesh nodes as a fraction of the local mesh size. For example, 0.1 permits perturbations up to 10% of the local size.

random-seed.description: Positive seed for reproducible triangle subdivision and node perturbation.

coord-scale-factor.description: Factor applied to all generated mesh coordinates.

rotation-angle.description: Counterclockwise rotation angle in degrees about the origin.
